ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This course will be delivered via Elluminate and managed through Compass. Students will need high speed internet connection and a headset with microphone or external microphone with speakers to interact during the online class sessions. A document scanner is required for both exams. A Saturday lab is tentatively scheduled for May 21 from 9 am to 3 pm on the Urbana campus. Participation in this lab is voluntary.
